workaround_applied: Manual pod resource override required — Airbyte replication orchestrator ignores global.workloads.resources Helm values and hardcodes 2 CPU / 2Gi per container. Pod was recreated with 250m CPU / 512Mi memory to fit cluster capacity.

bug_report.issue: Container resource requests hardcoded at 2 CPU / 2Gi memory despite global.workloads.resources.useConnectorResourceDefaults=false and explicit resource overrides in Helm values
bug_report.impact: Replication pods fail to schedule on resource-constrained clusters (typical OpenShift environments)
